# NEW 2026-11-24 v25.0-rc5: Variable-only Fourth Rome / Nova Elysia compatibility triggers.
# Keeps standalone 1337 main mod at 0 Unknown-trigger errors while remaining 100% reactive when
# paired with `oebyz.phoenix.1453_fourth_rome` (which strips its duplicate copies of these 6 triggers).
# Generated by decouple_v250_fourth_rome.py; edit the generator, not this file.

oe_ely_is_elysian_host = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	OR = {
		has_variable = oe_ely_is_elysia
		has_variable = oe_ely_is_nova_elysia
		has_variable = oe_ely_voyager
	}
}

oe_eln_is_elysia = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled
	OR = {
		has_variable = oe_ely_is_elysia
		has_variable = oe_ely_is_nova_elysia
	}
}

oe_eln_is_foederati_path = {
	has_variable = oe_eln_native_path
	var:oe_eln_native_path ?= 1
}

oe_eln_is_limes_path = {
	has_variable = oe_eln_native_path
	var:oe_eln_native_path ?= 2
}

oe_elr_is_elysia_host = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled
	OR = {
		has_variable = oe_ely_is_nova_elysia
		has_variable = oe_ely_is_elysia
		AND = {
			OR = {
				has_or_had_tag = BYZ
				has_or_had_tag = TRE
				has_or_had_tag = FEO
				has_or_had_tag = ROM
			}
			exists = capital
			OR = {
				capital.continent = continent:america
				has_global_variable = oe_elr_nostos_declared
				has_global_variable = oe_elr_grand_ending_achieved
			}
		}
	}
}

oe_elr_any_old_world_power_in_america = {
	OR = {
